newsitem.title: CANADA: Transwest in merger with Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Transwest in merger with Jordan.

text.p: Transwest Energy Inc, which placed itself on the auction block in October, said on Tuesday it agreed to a merger deal with Jordan Petroleum Ltd.
Transwest said that, under the proposed deal, its shareholders would have the option of accepting either C$1.05 cash or 0.13125 Jordan shares for each Transwest share.
The maximium number of Jordon shares to be issued under the agreement would total 5.56 million and the maximum amount of cash paid by Jordan would be C$14.8 million.
Transwest said its board of directors would recommend the Jordan deal to shareholders.

The acquisition agreement includes a C$2 million break fee to be paid to Jordan if the deal fails to materialize. The agreement also requires Tranwest to close its data room and stop soliciting offers for the company.
Transwest and Jordan said the combined company would produce about 16,900 barrels of oil equivalent per day and, based on current share prices, a market capitalization of C$250 million.
Transwest has a three percent overriding royalty on a stake in the Moose Mountain oil and gas discovery in western Alberta held by Rigel Energy Corp.
